name: remnote-koneko-theme
description: Soft pastel cat theme for RemNote. Costumed kittens in the corners, optional yarn chase, four shades.

scripts.clean: shx rm -rf build dist *.zip src/lib/assets.generated.ts src/lib/css.generated.ts
scripts.dev: npm run sources && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack serve --color --progress
scripts.css:copy: npm run sources --silent && node scripts/build-theme.mjs && node scripts/copy-css.mjs
scripts.build:theme: npm run sources && node scripts/build-theme.mjs && shx rm -f KonekoTheme.zip && bestzip KonekoTheme.zip theme.css manifest.json README.md logo.png
scripts.build:plugin: npm run sources && npx remnote-plugin validate && shx rm -rf dist && shx rm -f KonekoPlugin.zip && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --color && shx cp README.md dist && cd dist && bestzip ../KonekoPlugin.zip ./*
scripts.build: npm run build:theme && npm run build:plugin
